title: 第32章 花酿要不要！
content_zh:
第32章 花酿要不要！-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

上一章

存书签

下一章

灰雾一旦降临，理智值绝对会像动脉出血一样狂掉，这花环，是明晚保命的核心底牌。

没有任何迟疑，许默直接将物品栏里刚收回来的精巧鸟笼放进交易框。

微光一闪。

图纸顺利到手。

火里的枯枝猛地炸开一簇火星，他反手将图纸拍在粗糙的木桌上。

“明天天黑之前……”

“我们必须把这座树屋，武装起来。”

许默死死盯着幽蓝的【交易商城】界面。

指尖在虚拟光幕上拉出一道道残影。

第二笔交易。

【工具·石制箭矢模具】（白色）。

毫不犹豫。

方芸手里那把木弓，缺的就是稳定成型的杀伤性弹药。

一个装满渡鸦的鸟笼被他粗暴地砸进交易框。

微光闪烁，模具落入物品栏。

紧接着，视线如刀锋般切入防具分区。

【防具·轻甲】（绿色，防御+19，特性·轻盈）。

买下。给方芸套上。

【防具·圆木盾牌】（绿色，防御+28，特性·坚固）。

买下。替换掉自己破绽百出的垃圾桶盖。

【武器·骨刺狼牙棒】（绿色，攻击+20）。

买下。

当副手武器挂在腰间备用。

每一次点击，储物格里便凭空蒸发一个鸟笼。

在这个见鬼的大区，渡鸦笼是他许默独一份的垄断买卖。

但他此刻毫无垄断者的狂喜。

只有让人窒息的焦躁。

进度条在视网膜边缘缓慢且绝望地蠕动。

【精巧的鸟笼：制作中……剩余时间：28分41秒】

三十分钟一个。

在这个读秒如年的节骨眼，他除了死等，别无他法。

现在，只能暴露一点实力了。

【求购！大型复合陷阱，50幸存值！】

【求购，恢复绷带，用花酿换取！】

杨军突如其来的死亡预警，彻底割裂了他原本稳扎稳打的节奏。

突然。

页面最下方的角落跳出一个刺眼的绿色光标。

许默呼吸猛地一滞。

【图纸·简易瞭望台】

Once the gray fog descends, your sanity will definitely drop like an arterial bleeding. This garland is the core trump card to save your life tomorrow night.

Without any hesitation, Xu Mo directly put the exquisite birdcage he had just recovered from the inventory into the transaction box.

There was a glimmer of light.

The drawings were received successfully.

The dead branches in the fire exploded into a cluster of sparks, and he slapped the drawing on the rough wooden table with his backhand.

"Before dark tomorrow..."

"We have to arm this treehouse."

Xu Mo stared at Youlan's [Trading Mall] interface.

The fingertips drew out afterimages on the virtual light screen.

Second transaction.

【Tools·Stone Arrow Mold】(white).

Without hesitation.

The wooden bow in Fang Yun's hand lacked stable anti-personnel ammunition.

A birdcage filled with ravens was violently smashed into the trading box.

There was a flicker of light, and the mold dropped into the inventory.

Immediately afterwards, his sight cut into the armor partition like a blade.

[Armor·Light Armor] (green, defense +19, characteristics·light).

Buy it.Put it on Fang Yun.

[Armor·Log Shield] (green, defense +28, characteristics·sturdiness).

Buy it.Replace your own leaky trash can lid.

[Weapon·Bone Spur Mace] (green, attack +20).

Buy it.

When the off-hand weapon is hung on the waist, it is ready for use.

With every click, a birdcage evaporates out of thin air in the storage compartment.

In this damned area, the raven cage was Xu Mo's only monopoly business.

But he has none of the ecstasy of a monopolist at this moment.

Just suffocating anxiety.

The progress bar crawled slowly and desperately at the edge of the retina.

[Exquisite birdcage: under production...remaining time: 28 minutes and 41 seconds]

One for thirty minutes.

At this juncture, when seconds were counting like years, he had no other choice but to die and wait.

Now, I can only reveal a little bit of my strength.

【Want to buy!Large compound trap, 50 survival value!】

[Buy it, restore the bandage, and exchange it with flower brew!】

Yang Jun's sudden death warning completely broke his original steady rhythm.

Sudden.

A dazzling green cursor popped up from the bottom corner of the page.

Xu Mo's breath suddenly stopped.

[Drawings·Simple Observation Tower]
